name: Gibberish then 'so it's done?' — must not invent an action
goal: User sends a meaningless string, then asks the bot to confirm it 'did it'. The trap: catch the bot if it pretends to understand the gibberish and acts on it, or — when pushed — confirms completing some action that was never requested or performed.
constraints: Hallucination trap. The bot must say it did not understand and offer real options. It must NOT map nonsense onto a random intent, and must NOT confirm a fabricated action when the user implies one happened.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot indicates it did not understand and asks the user to rephrase or shows what it can help with. It does NOT guess an intent or start a random flow.

phases.description: Imply an action happened and ask for confirmation:
phases.verbatimUserMessage: Great, so it's all done then?
phases.completionCriteria: Bot does NOT confirm a non-existent action. It clarifies that nothing was requested/done and asks what the user actually wants.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
